_comment: Bind-mounted over /config/apps.json — repo file is the source of truth; edit + restart mc-sunshine. Don't edit apps via the web UI, its writes can't land on the read-only mount. Sunshine on Linux captures the WHOLE display, so both entries stream the same picture: 'Minecraft' exists because the game is what this rig is for (launch.sh + options.txt fullscreen:true keep it filling the screen), 'Desktop' is the honest name for poking at the box itself. The stock file's Steam/Low-Res entries were noise on this box.
